reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified on 2026-08-11. Issuer product, token-feature, and legal materials consistently state that each PGOLD represents 1 troy ounce of 99.99% purity physical gold meeting LBMA standards, with KYC-gated physical redemption. VISTO CPA's June 25, 2026 report independently confirms the Arbitrum 19,505-token liability figure and part of the bullion inventory, but physically counts only 50.86% of the claimed bullion, relies on shipping and issuer/insider assertions for the rest, excludes weight, purity, authenticity, and valuation, and does not cover the separate Ethereum native supply. The reserve category remains a single 100% commodity-allocated position; the report does not justify a stronger assurance or custody conclusion.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pleasing Gold product, token-feature, and legal disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve category is fully identified. A single independent report covers only the Arbitrum liability and a partly observed bullion inventory; recurring assurance, complete multi-chain liabilities, custody provider identity, segregation, rehypothecation, insurance, and redemption liquidity remain unresolved and are tracked in the mechanism and custody reviews.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Re-opened 2026-07-28: Terms still place vaulted metal with 'qualified custodians in Hong Kong' and say detailed custodian relationships 'are disclosed in the Transparency page,' but no public Transparency page or named vault/custodian list was found. How PGOLD works and the launch release restate institutional vault storage and Hong Kong redemption without naming providers. Segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation, insurance coverage, and current reserve evidence remain undisclosed.
